Service & Support In the event where the distance travelled exceeds the monthly usage variant, amount will be paid for additional Kms as per schedule. Similarly, the unused Kms in a particular month as against the minimum guaranteed usage variant will be carried forward to the next month and additional Km if any in the next month shall be adjusted against this. (5) Hiring of vehicle related to public safety, health, critical security operations and equi pment, hence experience and turnover of all firms are necessary to participate in th e bid as per given in bid. (6) All the bidder please note that please quote their rates with all taxes and duties as No any additional taxes like toll, octroi etc. will be paid by Railway Administration. Delhi section. (9) FASTag of vehicle shall have annual pass or shall always have Rs 500 balance else e very time suitable penalty will be imposed by the user if vehicle detained at toll due no balance in fast tagg. (10) Vehicle is required to run in emergencies hence fuel tank shall in no way less than h alf tank full. (11) Vehicle will equire to run in CPYZ-CNB section or other work area of Dy CSTE/proj ect/ALJN office. (12) Vehicle may be based at Chipyana, Dadri, Khurja, Aligarh, Hathras, Tundla, Shikoha bad and Karura on monthly basis as per requirement of work in section.
